metadata.title: That 2 kill spree where Valorant said ‘I guess you get it today’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, how did I even pull that off?
Enemy just gave me trophies like it was a giveaway.
Click if your aim’s a mess but the kills keep showing up.
Valorant logic made a surprise cameo again.

Tap if your best kills feel like accidental legends!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
